**Daily Devotional**

**June 7**

*13 Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man: (James 1:13 KJV)*

God is a Good God. He never tempts us with evil. All evil temptations come from the author of evil, the Devil. Notice that it doesn’t say that God never tempts us at all, but only that He will never tempt us with evil. God does sometimes put temptations in our paths - but never evil ones. James is making it clear that all evil comes from the author of everything evil, the Devil (John 10:10), and we need to resist the Devil and he will flee from us (James 4:7), if we are submitted to God and serving Him.

It must please the Devil that the Church has many times credited God with the evil things that happen in this world, as that is blasphemy against the Holy Ghost, and can cause a born again Christian to go to hell (Matt. 12:31-32). For an example of this happening to a Pastor named Daniel, see our web page “New Revelations”. For religion to say that God causes and controls all the things that happen in our lives, is giving God the blame for all the bad things that this world and the Devil throws at us. It is a doctrine of the Devil to say that God controls everything and nothing happens but what God causes it or approves of it. This is just not so, and God has limited Himself by giving mankind a free will (Deuteronomy 30:19), and He does not control all that happens to us. The Devil and his demons, as well as us, cause all the bad things that happen, and not our God. God is good (James 1:17), and should never be blamed for what the Devil does or things that we cause ourselves. Praise God for His goodness.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
